artifacts.description: The sole EHI export documentation. A 4-page PDF (v1.0, dated November 2023, authored by CS Sekhar) containing: page 1 = header info and format description; pages 2-4 = 11 UI screenshots showing login, navigation to Settings > Interoperability > Data Export > Generate Summaries, patient search, single/multi-patient export, scheduled export configuration, and role-based access denial.
